estimands.negative_direction: intact target names have greater NK-directed output leverage

inference_assumptions.exact_binomial_sign: one-sided exact binomial sign test with ties counted against the registered direction
inference_assumptions.exact_rademacher: exact enumeration over 2^8 sign assignments, conditional on donor-effect sign symmetry; not distribution-free
inference_assumptions.student_t: Student-t7 intervals treat the eight frozen donor effects as independent donor-level observations

inference_unit: one held-out cell per donor; donor is the unit
interpretation_boundary: held-out-cell text-interface dependence in one model and one eight-donor SLE control cohort; not a biological perturbation, pathway mechanism, annotation-truth validation, latent-knowledge proof, hidden-state activation-gap test, mathematical invariant, or physical law

formulas.probability_alignment: all forms aligned to P(CD8) first

provenance.plan_construction: SHA256-sort by analysis ID, model, and stable request ID
